module.name: Neurosurgery Patient View Override
module.author: Hani
module.description: Simple override of the patient view for neurosurgery departments. Replaces the default coreapps patient page with a neurosurgery-focused view.

privilege.name: View Neurosurgery Data
privilege.description: Able to view neurosurgery patient-view records (antecedents, exams, diagnosis, pathology, etc.)

privilege.name: Manage Neurosurgery Data
privilege.description: Able to create and update neurosurgery patient-view records

privilege.name: App: patientview.neurosurgeryDashboard
privilege.description: Able to see and open the Neurosurgery Dashboard (read-only access) - assign to nurses

privilege.name: App: patientview.neurosurgeryDashboard.manage
privilege.description: Able to add and edit neurosurgery patient-view records from the dashboard - assign to surgeons and radiologists (in addition to the view privilege above)
